textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Badal and Moti (story) · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Badal is a boy who lives with his mother in a village, and they are very happy. One evening, when Badal is coming back from school, he sees a puppy shivering in the cold and brings it home.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Badal is a boy who lives with his mother in a village, and they are very happy. One evening, when Badal is coming back from school, he sees a puppy shivering in the cold and brings it home.
beats.speakEn: Badal is a boy who lives with his mother in a village, and they are very happy. One evening, when Badal is coming back from school, he sees a puppy shivering in the cold and brings it home.

beats.en: One rainy day Badal slips on a muddy lane and falls into a deep pit. He tries hard but cannot climb out. When Badal does not come home on time, his mother is worried and gathers the neighbours to search for him.
beats.speakEn: One rainy day Badal slips on a muddy lane and falls into a deep pit. He tries hard but cannot climb out. When Badal does not come home on time, his mother is worried and gathers the neighbours to search for him.

textbookBox.concept: The words lived, loved, played, gathered and thanked all end with ed. These words tell us about actions that have already happened. This is called the past.
